d12111d3a9.why: Both sets of four signed multiply-adds feed required results, and the duplicated input lanes, shifted accumulator, and final temporary are also live.

69cd7eccbc.why: Both broadcast vectors and both blended vectors are required final values, so none of the four instructions can be removed.
